name: Peter Luth
profile: Danish technologist (Peter Lüth) who co-founded Copenhagen payments company Flatpay in 2022 with Sander Janca-Jensen, Rasmus Busk and Rasmus Hellmund Carlsen, and leads its technology as CTO. Flatpay offers small merchants flat-fee card terminals and reached a €1.5B valuation after a €145M round.
interesting_fact: Flatpay was reported as the fastest Danish company ever to become a unicorn; its four co-founders had built startups together before.
deep_cut_fact: In 2013 he was one of the founding team of Mofibo, a Danish all-you-can-read e-book subscription startup (backed by SEED Capital before launch), described then as its 'IT specialist'; Mofibo was later acquired by Storytel.

public_contacts.value: christian.gronning@flatpay.dk (Christian Grønning, Global Head of Communications)

notes: Name is spelled Peter Lüth. Very low public profile; no interviews found. Storytel acquisition of Mofibo is well known but not cited in the linked article.

name: Mark Davidson
current_role: Co-founder & Chief Growth Officer, Octane (New York)
profile: Boston University alumnus and growth marketer who co-founded powersports/RV financing fintech Octane in 2014 with CEO Jason Guss, serving over time as CRO/CMO and now Chief Growth Officer. Octane's lender Roadrunner Financial funds over $1B of loans a year; the company raised a $100M Series F in Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: Octane partners with OEMs such as BRP and Forest River to run their branded financing programs, and was named an ABS Issuer of the Year at the 2026 GlobalCapital US Securitization Awards.
deep_cut_fact: Before Octane he co-founded oDigger and Cheggin, and describes himself as a 'high performance marketer & conversion optimizer'; he is associated with accelerator DreamIt, an early Octane backer.
notes: Common name — confirm via Octane affiliation. Current title from Octane's 'Who We Are' leadership list (https://octane.co/o/who-we-are/).

name: Vitaly Chipounov
current_role: Co-founder & Chief Architect, Cyberhaven (per EPFL DSLAB alumni listing)
profile: Computer scientist (EPFL PhD 2014, George Candea's lab) and the lead author of S2E, the open-source selective-symbolic-execution platform. He co-founded data-security company Cyberhaven in 2016 with Candea and fellow lab members and serves as its Chief Architect; Cyberhaven sells data-lineage-based data loss prevention and is valued at $1B+.
interesting_fact: His PhD thesis 'S2E: A Platform for In-Vivo Multi-Path Analysis of Software Systems' produced a tool security researchers have used to find Windows, Linux and Android kernel CVEs.
deep_cut_fact: Cyberhaven built the 'Galactica' system on S2E for the DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge finals (CodeJitsu team, with UC Berkeley and Syracuse); S2E drew 'first blood' by exploiting 7 binaries before anyone else and launched 392 successful attacks — about twice as many as Mayhem.

public_contacts.value: http://s2e.systems/ (S2E project site, his PhD work)

notes: Deeply technical; S2E/Cyber Grand Challenge are the best conversation hooks. Title from https://dslab.epfl.ch/people.
